title: Prepped and Polished  - Videos
description:
Prepped and Polished® is a boutique tutoring company serving Greater Boston families since 1999. Smarter Prep, Stronger Results™.

We offer one-to-one academic tutoring, test preparation (SAT, ACT, ISEE, SSAT), Executive Function Playbook© coaching, and college admissions guidance — online or in person at our offices in Wellesley, Newton, Lexington, and Weston, MA.

Every student receives a Prepped Progress Report℠ after each session, so parents always know exactly what was covered and what's next.

On this channel you'll find free test prep tips, study strategies, and college admissions advice to help students of all ages gain a competitive edge. New videos posted regularly — subscribe and hit the notification bell so you never miss one.

📍 Wellesley · Newton · Lexington · Weston · Online
